sources.entry: Site Reliability Engineering Paris, France - SRE Meetup in the city of light.

summary.name: Site Reliability Engineering France
summary.one_liner: A Meetup community for French-speaking people interested in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), with discussions, news and a job board.
use_cases: Finding other SRE practitioners in France
Discussing SRE best practices and problems
Learning how to create an SRE team
Following SRE news via a Telegram channel
Searching for SRE job offers in France or remote
summary.what_it_does: The page is the Meetup group page for Site Reliability Engineering in France, aimed at people in SRE teams, people building one, and those curious about the topic. The group describes itself as a place to exchange on best practices, problems, tools and experiences related to SRE. It points to a Telegram group for discussion and a Telegram broadcast channel for news. It also links to an SRE Jobs Board listing openings in France and remote. The page shows 29 past events, and the listing describes it as an SRE meetup in Paris.
notable: Community for French-speaking SRE practitioners across France, with a Paris-based meetup
Companion Telegram discussion group and a broadcast news channel
Linked SRE Jobs Board covering France and remote roles
29 past events listed on the group page
caveats: Page text is in French and gives no pricing or event schedule details
Upcoming events and membership costs are not stated on the page
